g.text: Design files referenced to generate Altium files
AM62L EVM design files on TI.com have been used for converting the Orcad/Allegro design to Altium design files
Use case for the Altium files
List of Altium converted files provided
We have customer requesting for Altium files and using the .ALG files. The .ALG file is an intermediate converted file
The Altium converted schematics and PCB files provided has most of the constraints translated and close the Orcad/Allegro design files
The simulations have been performed on Orcad/Allegro design files
Refer to Proc180E1-1_Altium_Folders_Files_List document in the download Zip file
The required reviews for the converted files have been provided. The boards have not been built and tested. Orcad/Allegro design-based boards have been built and tested.
Customer can use the files to make the required updates. The recommendation is for customer to perform a detailed review to ensure there are no errors before start of board builds
Note for customer before using the Altium files
